name: Sweet Stewed Rhubarb Side Dish
whyItWorks: Simmered down until soft and tender with sugar, stewed rhubarb provides soluble pectin and gentle fruit fiber that supports digestion. Cooking thoroughly breaks down stringy plant cellulose.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Enjoy a few spoonfuls as a tart-sweet digestive accompaniment. Avoid if prone to calcium-oxalate issues.
